scientific_summary: On BAKEOFF01 near-tie timing, the combined point-estimate winner is gradient_boosted_trees from BAKEOFF01 at sigma68 1.127 ns; the best BAKEOFF02 external candidate is xgboost at 1.146 ns. On injected-truth anomaly classification, the combined point-estimate winner is hist_gradient_boosting from BAKEOFF01 at ROC AUC 0.868; the best BAKEOFF02 external candidate is lightgbm at 0.846. Therefore the BAKEOFF01 recommendation table is stable under this XGBoost/LightGBM/compact-transformer audit.
